phases.riskIfSkipped: Misaligned expectations, scope creep, margin erosion
Wrong products ordered, costly changes post-manufacture
Quality defects not caught before arrival, late delivery
Delivery failure, damaged goods, building access denied
Unsafe install, poor finish quality, missed defects
Client dissatisfaction, no referral, warranty disputes

projectDocumentation.rationale: Documentation protects TCD from scope creep claims and provides a clear record if warranty disputes arise

topRisks.mitigation: Always build 1-week buffer. Never lock installation date until PC is confirmed in writing.
Get signed finish schedule before ordering. Clearly state that changes post-manufacture incur cost.
Place orders with 20% buffer before needed delivery date. Follow up with supplier at weeks 2, 4, and 1 week before ship date.
All goods insured. Photograph at receiving. Report damage to supplier within 48 hours with photos.
Any addition to scope after sign-off is priced and quoted separately. Never absorb extras silently.

milestoneCommunication.principle: Proactively communicate project status — never make clients chase for updates
touchpoints: Delivery booking confirmation (5 days before delivery)

additions: Phase plan if multi-zone or multi-floor
